caption: The image is a drawing of a single object, a beaker, centered on the paper. The beaker is conical, with a wider top that narrows slightly towards the base. The surface of the beaker features engraved or etched decorative patterns, including floral and circular motifs. The color of the beaker itself is rendered in shades of gray and black, with darker shading to indicate curvature and depth, suggesting a metallic material. The background consists of a pale beige color with patchy areas of rusty brown and light orange washes, giving a textured appearance. At the top center of the drawing, the word "BEAKER" is printed in uppercase letters, while "CASE NO 1" appears in the top left corner.
